name: Loop-SaboteurXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: A port of Loop Saboteur by Stephen McLeod Blythe (clickysteve): a glitch / chop / beat-slicer that records the last bars and sabotages them on the MPC tempo with retriggered, pitched, reversed, stretched and crushed slices. Eight Acts, a 64-step sequencer with trig conditions, ratchets and p-locks, four MODs per Act, eleven output stages, 19 factory presets, a big readout and 16 banks. Art and build by Claude.
